sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: CAA/EAA column: on large pages the type letters (F B Sp M Bk T) no longer drop to a second line while the artwork is still loading. The column resize ran before most artwork had arrived and sized the column to its header; it now reserves the width of a fully loaded line (icon, count, every type letter with a repeat count) from the start, for the page-wide and the per-sub-table resize.
